basis: Leghemoglobin (O2 buffering for nitrogenase). Promoter-GUS marks the last stage of the infected lineage (NF2 9.95 vs 2.72) (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant), and it is a Xenium top-3 marker of infected cells (InNF, Fig 1F/G) (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Two independent spatial validations, so raised medium->high. UniProt G7KGS8 calls it Lb120-1; UniProt P27992 'Lb1' is a different locus (MtLb2 here). Lbs are ambient in protoplast data: never use as a negative marker.

Most abundant leghemoglobin. Xenium top-3 of InNF and infected cells at 49 DPI (Fig 1F, 2E-F) (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv); NF2 191 vs NA1 76 and MIX 61 in scRNA (strong ambient spillover) (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant). High from in situ + function (Jhu); Ye enrichment adds agreement. Positive marker only. UniProt P27992 names it Lb6/Lb1/Lb2.
Nodule-specific cysteine-rich peptide; Xenium top-3 of InNF (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Single study.
Symbiosome-localized calmodulin-like protein (Liu 2006, cited); NF2 11.93 vs 2.04 (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant). [Fixation_Zone_Infected]
NIN-like TF activating Lb expression and N fixation (Jiang 2021, cited); NF2 1.89 vs 0.25 (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant). Stage-restricted (fixation zone). [Fixation_Zone_Infected]
Symbiosome copper transporter needed for N fixation (Senovilla 2018, cited); NF2 3.29 vs NF1 2.04 (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant). [Fixation_Zone_Infected]
GLUTAMINE DUMPER homolog; NF2 0.93 vs 0.20, low level (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant). [Fixation_Zone_Infected]

Nodule-specific signal peptidase subunit needed for NCR delivery and N fixation (Wang 2010, cited); IF 8.39 and NF1 6.74 vs PI 3.42, so it marks young infected cells (infection zone to interzone) (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant). Single scRNA study; high from function.
PI-PLC-like protein needed for bacteroid persistence (cited); IF 3.45, NF1 3.09, NF2 2.40: broad across the infected lineage (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant).

Nodule glycine-rich peptide. Promoter-GUS marks the third stage of the infected lineage (NF1 10.69 vs 1.41) (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant); Xenium marker of IZ_R108 and of infected cells in the 49-DPI infection zone/interzone (Fig 1F, 2C-D) (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Two independent spatial validations, raised medium->high. UniProt G7KH53 and the GFF name this locus NodGRP1C (the paper's NodGRP1C is Chr5g0438231): match by ID.
NCR peptide in bacteroid differentiation (Farkas 2014, cited); NF1 2.10 vs UN1 1.26, weak specificity (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant).
DEMETER DNA demethylase, interzone-expressed and required for nodule differentiation (Satge 2016, cited); NF1 0.85 vs IF 0.41 (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant).
NCR peptide; Xenium top-3 of IZ_R108 (Fig 1F) (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv). alt_id is a partial blastp hit (94%).
ABC-A transporter; Xenium top-3 of IZ_R108 (Fig 1F) (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Uncharacterized here; medium only because the evidence is cell-resolution spatial; targeted 405-gene panel.

Proline-rich early nodulin of the infection program (Pichon et al. 1992 Plant Cell, in situ). Proximal infection zone IF 7.68 vs PI 3.59 (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant); Xenium marker of IF_R108 and of infected cells in the 49-DPI infection zone (Fig 1F, 2C-D) (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Ye enrichment + Jhu in situ + Pichon 1992: raised medium->high.

Stress up-regulated Nod19. Promoter-GUS marks the second stage along the nodule axis (IF 5.25 vs PI 1.31) (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant); Xenium top-3 of IF_R108 (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Two independent spatial validations, raised medium->high. Mt4.0 hit 94.9% identity.

Nodulin expressed ahead of infection threads (Mathis 1999, cited); distal infection zone PI 0.23 vs 0.13 (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant); Xenium top-3 of IF_R108 (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Ye enrichment is weak, so Jhu in situ + Ye agreement gives low->medium.

Repetitive proline-rich cell-wall early nodulin; pENOD11 reporter in cells of the infection program (Journet et al. 2001 MPMI). Distal infection zone (pre-infected) PI 2.26 vs NA2 0.83 (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant). Reporter study + independent cluster enrichment: raised medium->high.

ERF required for infection (Cerri 2012, cited); distal infection zone PI 0.18 vs 0.07 (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant). ID UNCONFIRMED: the paper's r1.7 ID is absent from LIS ann1_6; alt_id is UniProt A2Q5W1 matched by symbol only.
ERF required for nodule differentiation (Vernie 2008, cited); proximal infection zone IF 4.59 vs PI 3.05 (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant).

Matrix metalloproteinase-like protein needed for infection-thread progression (Combier 2007, cited); IF 2.44 vs 0.80 (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant). Lowered medium->low because the ID is UNCONFIRMED (absent from LIS ann1_6 and UniProt; no Mt4.0 alt_id).

Nod factor-binding lectin-nucleotide phosphohydrolase; promoter-GUS marks the earliest stage along the central axis (PI 7.68 vs IF 2.55) (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant). CONFLICT: Jhu 2026 Xenium puts it in root+nodule vascular endodermis (RNV_Endo top-3); lowered medium->low. See the Nodule_Vascular_Endodermis row.
Plasma-membrane H+-ATPase; Xenium top-3 of IF_IZ_A17 (infection zone + interzone merged) (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Medium for cell-resolution spatial; single study.
GH3 auxin-conjugating enzyme; Xenium top-3 of IF_IZ_A17 (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Single study.
Xenium top-3 of IF_IZ_A17 (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Uncharacterized; single study.

Asparagine synthetase (Asn for N export). MtAS1pro:MtAS1-GFP specific to fixation-zone uninfected cells; UiC2 37.5 vs 9.3; UIC-enriched in LCM data (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant); Xenium top-3 of UninNF (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Two independent validations, raised medium->high. Its Asn role in these cells is inferred.

Asparagine synthetase; GFP fusion in fixation-zone uninfected cells (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant) (scRNA UiC2 73 vs NA2 40, weak cluster specificity); Xenium in situ in upper UninNF at 49 DPI (Fig 2E-F) (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Two spatial validations: high. Also the top marker of Jhu NEP (epidermis+parenchyma), so not exclusive.

Nodule lectin; Xenium in situ marks uninfected cells (UninNF; UninIFZ at 49 DPI; Fig 1G, 2D) (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Ye 2022: UiC2 17.7 and UiC1 13.2 vs 6.1, but promoter-GUS is broad (meristem periphery, ZII, IZ). Not raised to high because Ye's reporter conflicts on specificity.
GASA/snakin; promoter-GUS in fixation-zone uninfected cells and around the nodule endodermis; UiC2 6.06 vs 2.06 (moderate in NP) (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant).
bHLH reported in fixation-zone uninfected cells and vasculature (Godiard 2011, cited); UiC2 0.41, UiC1 0.33 vs 0.11 (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant).
Nitrate reductase; Xenium top-3 of UninNF (Fig 1F) (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Single study.
Plastid Fd-GOGAT; UiC2 0.32 vs 0.12, low level (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant).
GLUTAMINE DUMPER homolog; UiC2 0.59 vs IF 0.19 (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant).

PLETHORA AP2 TF of the root stem-cell program reused in the central nodule meristem (Franssen et al. 2015 Development); Xenium top-3 of NAC_CM (apex cortex + central meristem, no cell-cycle genes) (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv); trace in Ye NA1. Reporter study + independent spatial cluster: raised medium->high. NAC_CM is merged with apex cortex.

PLETHORA AP2 TF in the central nodule meristem (Franssen et al. 2015 Development); Ye 2022 NA2 0.86 vs PI 0.53 (weak) in a cluster partly called from G2/M genes. Not raised: Ye enrichment is not cluster-specific.
PLETHORA AP2 TF at the nodule meristem periphery (Franssen et al. 2015 Development). From the characterized-marker survey; not in either single-cell review.

NBCL2-clade BOP paralog expressed in the nodule central meristem (Magne et al. 2018 Plant Physiol). From the characterized-marker survey; noot1/2 mutants were profiled in Jhu 2026 but no cluster marker is reported.
NAC TF; promoter-GUS in a very small group of meristem cells; NA2 6.65 vs NP 1.46 (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant).
LBD TF; Xenium top-3 of NAC_CM (apex cortex + central meristem) (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Single study.
GRF-interacting factor; Xenium top-3 of NAC_CM, low specificity (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv). alt_id blastp 93%.
BOP-type co-regulator maintaining nodule identity at the nodule vascular meristem; ortholog of LjNBCL1 and PsCOCH1 (Magne et al. 2018 Plant Physiol). From the characterized-marker survey.

Chalcone synthase (flavonoid pathway; NA1 GO-enriched for flavonoid synthesis); promoter-GUS in a few cell layers at the distal nodule end; NA1 9.29 vs NP 2.25 (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant). Meristem vs apical outer tissue unresolved (Ye 'Nodule_Meristem_Distal').

PR10-family nodulin, reported nodule-apex/outer-cortex specific (Gamas 1996/1998, cited by Ye); Xenium top-3 of NOC_RC (nodule outer cortex merged with root cortex), also high in NAC_CM (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv); Ye NA1 (distal apex) 0.45 vs 0.09 at low level. Not raised: the two clusters are not the same compartment.
Nodulin; Xenium top-3 of NOC_RC (merged with root cortex) (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv).

Early nodulin-75-like HRGP; in situ in nodule parenchyma (van de Wiel et al. 1990 EMBO J, pea/soybean). NP 140.7 vs 11.3 (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant); Xenium top-3 of NPC_RIC, labelled MtN8|MtLP14 (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Three independent lines: high.
Uncharacterized protein; promoter-GUS in peripheral nodule tissue; NP 17.36 vs 2.76 (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant).

UMAMIT amino-acid exporter. Promoter-GUS in a layer surrounding the central tissue (Ye 'UN1', 10.7 vs 0.88) (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant); Xenium in situ in nodule vascular endodermis (Fig 1G) (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv), which recasts Ye's UN1 as vascular endodermis. Two spatial validations, raised medium->high. ID from Ye's table (not shown in Jhu).
UMAMIT; Ye UN1 7.61 vs 0.79, no reporter (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant); UN1 = vascular endodermis per Jhu 2026 UMAMIT14 in situ.
PIN auxin efflux carrier; Xenium top-3 of NV_Endo (spatially discrete nodule vascular endodermis) (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv).
Xenium top-3 of NV_Endo (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Single study.
Xenium top-3 of NV_Endo (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Single study.
ROOT DETERMINED NODULATION1 (autoregulation); Xenium top-3 of RNV_Endo, which merges root and nodule vascular endodermis (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Low: merged cluster, single study.
Xenium top-3 of RNV_Endo (root + nodule vascular endodermis) (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv). CONFLICT with Ye 2022 promoter-GUS at the distal infection zone (see Infection_Zone row); low until resolved.
Isoflavone 2'-hydroxylase-like P450; promoter-GUS along nodule vascular bundles; VA 16.6 vs 0.81 (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant). Xylem/phloem/pericycle not separated.
NADPH oxidase with nodule vascular expression (Marino 2011, cited); VA 15.0 vs NP 7.9 (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant).
Tonoplast aquaporin; VA 3.02 vs 0.09, cluster-specific but no reporter (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant).
Amino-acid transporter; VA 8.46 vs NP 1.76 (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant).
APC/C activator (mitotic); Xenium top-3 of the 14-DPI 'RNV_Peri' cluster, which is a proliferation state (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv). UniProt A0A396ISC0 (reviewed).
Mitotic kinase family; Xenium top-3 of 'RNV_Peri' (proliferation) (Jhu et al. 2026 bioRxiv). Single study.
G2/M B-type CDK; used by Ye to call NA2 'meristem' (NA2 0.12 vs 0.03) (Ye et al. 2022 Mol Plant). Proliferation, not identity.
